name: FO-29
note: Linear transponder for SSB and CW.
amsatStatusSource: AMSAT status page satellite list (https://www.amsat.org/status/), checked 2026-10-19

profile.builtBy: JARL, the Japan Amateur Radio League
profile.story: Fuji-OSCAR 29 (JAS-2) carries a linear transponder: instead of one shared channel, it relays a whole slice of spectrum, so several SSB and CW contacts can share it at once, each on its own frequency.
